thread:
lena (Content): Quick huddle: we need a compact competitor battlecard + a launch post draft by Tue. Focus: cloud AI platforms, public LLM APIs, infra vendors. Keep each bucket to 3 bullets max.
marco (DemandGen): For webinar narrative, lead with economics for PMs, then a short demo showing routing and fallback. CTA: resource download + perf appendix.
izzy (Field): Useful field soundbites: 1) "We had 2x paging incidents after a big model update" 2) "Switching runtimes broke our observability" 1 these map to reliability + ops cost rebut angles.
chris (Product): Benchmark guidance: don't publish raw p99s in marketing. Use customer-observed ranges and link to an appendix. Example phrasing: "Customers report up to ~40% reduction in unit cost under steady high-throughput workloads."
lena (Content): Micro-rebuts (one-liners) proposals:
- vs cloud AI: "Predictable spend + SLA-backed fallbacks when capacity shifts."
- vs LLM APIs: "Not just model access  a single runtime for all deployments."
- vs infra vendors: "Drive down ops overhead without sacrificing control."
marco (DemandGen): Social hero A/B for ads & post:
- Econ-first: "Lower inference spend. Same quality. See benchmarks."
- Trust-first: "SLA-backed inference across hosted, dedicated & private."
izzy (Field): SDR quick plays (short):
- Cold: "Are you seeing surprises on inference costs? We map model runs to dollars. 15 mins?"
- Reply when they say 'we self-host': "Totally—we help teams keep self-host benefits while reducing ops & tail risk. Quick side-by-side?"
chris (Product): Inbound routing tags for HubSpot (copyable):
```
hubspot_tags:
  - trigger: "compliance"
    tag: "private_sales"
  - trigger: "cost"
    tag: "benchmark_followup"
  - trigger: "self-host"
    tag: "dedicated_trial"
  - trigger: "latency"
    tag: "perf_demo"
```
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar assets uploaded -> /drive/webinar/2026-q2/launch-v2 (access: marketing,demandgen,sales)
lena (Content): Case study blurb for battlecard (30 words): "Fintech X reduced inference surprises by consolidating runtimes on Redwood: fewer incidents, clearer bills, and a predictable rollout path for model updates." Keep it non-specific and PR-safe.
marco (DemandGen): Landing page hero candidates (short):
- "Engineering-grade inference that scales from dev to SLA-backed prod."
- "Predictable inference economics and built-in fallbacks. Register for live benchmarks."
izzy (Field): Field check: for infra vendors add one line: "Avoid stitching multiple vendor SDKs  spikes in MTTR and integration debt."
chris (Product): Can we get a one-slide appendix that explains 'fallbacks' in plain English? I'll draft with a small diagram.
lena (Content): Action list: 1) @chris draft fallback appendix (tomorrow AM). 2) @marco pick hero variant & ad copy (EOD). 3) @izzy add 3 field quotes & one infra example (tomorrow). 4) @lena assemble battlecard + SDR scripts, drop in #sales-assets. Review Wed 09:00 PT. Short thread, reply here with any edits. :sparkles:
